studio.title: Lock Studio
studio.presets.empty: Presets you save show here. Applying changes to a built-in preset asks for a name.
studio.presets.deleteBody: It goes from Your presets. The lock screen keeps the look it has. This can't be undone.
studio.presetName.newBody: You changed %1. Name your version to keep it in Your presets and apply it.
studio.presetName.copyBody: This look goes into Your presets under a new name, and is applied.
studio.presetName.renameBody: The look stays as it is.
studio.presetName.label: Name
studio.presetName.invalid: Use 1 to 64 characters, without line breaks.
studio.presetName.plainHint: Applies the look as it is, without keeping it in Your presets.
studio.applyBlocked: Fix the problems on your screens first.
studio.state.caption: Preview
studio.lookHint: Nothing is selected: these settings apply to the whole lock screen. Click a module to edit it.
studio.tip.mugshot: Your picture and name on the lock screen come from your account. Set them with Mugshot.
studio.tip.mugshotMissing: Your picture and name on the lock screen come from your account. Set them with Mugshot: install it with omarchy-pkg-add mugshot, then come back here.
studio.tip.drag: Hold Shift while you drag to place a module without snapping, and Alt to keep it on one axis.
studio.tip.keys: Ctrl+arrows move the selected module to the next zone.
studio.passwordAlways: The password field is always shown.
studio.sample.conditionLong: Heavy rain and thunder with strong gusts along the coast tonight
studio.problem.password-covered: Something covers the password field on %1
studio.problem.password-offscreen: The password field goes off screen on %1
studio.problem.password-high: The password field is in the top third on %1
studio.problem.password-missing: The password field is missing on %1
studio.style.name: Name
studio.dragHint: drag onto the canvas to place it
studio.screensHint: Primary: only on the screen you type the password on.
studio.reveal.hint: While typing: the field shows with the first key, or when a check or a wrong password needs it. The unlock hint always shows.
studio.alignHint: Zone: the text lines up as its zone does. Start, Centre or End keep it that way in any zone, and move it within the zone when it is narrower.
studio.textAlign.hint: The hint, the placeholder and what you type. Auto: the style's own.
studio.submit.hint: Off, the arrow is left out and the hint gets its room. Enter still unlocks.
studio.items.hint: An item with nothing to show, like a battery on a desktop, is left out.
studio.items.keys: Space switches an item; Alt+Up and Alt+Down move it.
studio.details.card: The card always shows the condition and today’s high and low.
studio.location.note: Off by default: anyone who sees your lock screen can read it.
studio.weather.sample: The canvas shows sample weather, never yours. The lock screen shows what Foamy Weather fetches.
studio.coverArt.note.off: The music icon shows in place of covers.
studio.coverArt.note.player: Covers the player keeps on this computer. Nothing is downloaded.
studio.coverArt.note.spotify: Also Spotify’s covers, downloaded from i.scdn.co while you’re unlocked, so Spotify sees your IP address. Every cover is checked and decoded in the sandbox first.
studio.coverArt.note.custom: shell.json lists artwork hosts of your own. A choice here replaces them.
studio.coverArt.setting: A lock screen setting for every look, saved at once (undo doesn’t cover it).
studio.coverArt.older: The running Foamy Lock can't set cover art. Restart the Omarchy shell.
studio.artwork: Show the cover in this look
studio.artwork.hint: Off, the music icon shows in its place in this look, whatever the setting.
studio.needsWeather.hint: Needs Foamy Weather: the lock screen gets the weather from it. Install it and turn on its service to show the weather.
studio.settingHidesAccount: The lock screen's settings hide the account (Show user info is off).
studio.settingHidesMedia: The lock screen's settings hide the media player (Show media is off).
studio.hiddenHint: Hidden. Switch it on, or drag it from the library onto the canvas.
studio.glassLook: As set under Glass and dim
studio.picture.missing: The picture is gone: choose it again.
studio.picture.failed: The lock screen can't show this picture (%1).
studio.pick.title: Choose a picture or video for the lock screen
studio.pick.NO_SESSION_BUS: The file chooser needs a session bus, and there is none.
studio.pick.PORTAL_FAILED: The file chooser failed. Try again.
studio.pick.UNSUPPORTED: The lock screen can't use that file: choose a .png, .jpg or .webp picture, or an .mp4, .mov, .mkv or .webm video.
studio.helperUnavailable: This plugin's helper isn't available for this CPU.
studio.wallpaperVideo: A video wallpaper without a still frame: the canvas shows the theme colour, as the lock screen does.
studio.wallpaperMissing: No wallpaper found: the canvas shows the theme colour.
studio.shapes.empty: No shapes. Add one, or wrap a module in one from its inspector.
studio.shape.full: A look has four shapes at most, two of them frosted.
studio.shape.noRoom: No room for %1: four shapes at most, two of them frosted.
studio.shape.pickModule: Select a module first, then add a shape around it.
studio.shape.band: The bottom row sits in this band.
studio.shape.fill.autoHint: Auto follows the glass tint: dark on clear glass, the tinted glass otherwise.
studio.shape.frostNote: Frost blurs a picture background, with GPU rendering only.
studio.shape.absorbNote: The password field keeps its own.
studio.problem.shape-straddles: %1 crosses the edge of shape %2 on %3

studio.presetAskBody.one: You have %1 change. Keep it on %2, or replace it with the preset as it comes? Either can be undone.
studio.presetAskBody.other: You have %1 changes. Keep them on %2, or replace them with the preset as it comes? Either can be undone.

studio.presetCantKeep: The lock screen can't keep these changes on that preset.
studio.reset.title: Reset the look?
studio.reset.body: Go back to the look the lock screen has now, or start over from the preset %1 without your changes. You can undo either.
studio.reset.savedHint: The look the lock screen has now.
studio.matchesLock: The lock screen has this look
studio.previewHint: Shows this look full screen in the lock screen's own preview. Nothing is saved.
studio.result.invalid-json: The lock screen couldn't read the look.
studio.result.invalid: The lock screen refused the look: %1
studio.result.locked.apply: The screen is locked, so nothing was saved.
studio.result.locked.preview: The screen is locked, so the preview can't open.
studio.result.unsupported: This Omarchy can't save plugin settings.
studio.result.no-entry: Foamy Lock has no entry in shell.json to save to.
studio.result.unexpected: The lock screen gave an answer Lock Studio doesn't know.
studio.result.not-responding: The Omarchy shell didn't answer. Try again.
studio.result.not-responding.apply: No answer from the Omarchy shell: the look may or may not be saved.
studio.result.write-failed: Omarchy can't read shell.json, so nothing was saved.
studio.result.full: 50 presets is the most. Delete one first.
studio.result.too-large: Your presets would pass 256 KiB. Delete one first.
studio.result.unknown-preset: That preset isn't in shell.json any more.
studio.result.not-responding.preset: No answer from the Omarchy shell: the preset may or may not be saved.
studio.presetAskReplace: Your changes aren't kept in a preset. Replace them with %1? You can undo it.
studio.result.not-ready: The Omarchy shell is still starting. Try again in a moment.
studio.result.target-not-found: Foamy Lock isn't loaded in the Omarchy shell.
studio.result.function-not-found: The running Foamy Lock is older than Lock Studio. Restart the Omarchy shell.
studio.result.error: Lock Studio couldn't send the look (%1).
studio.draft.corrupt: The saved draft couldn't be read and was set aside.
studio.draft.loadFailed: The saved draft couldn't be read (%1).
studio.draft.saveFailed: The draft couldn't be saved (%1). Your changes stay until you quit.
studio.draft.clearFailed: The old draft couldn't be deleted (%1).
studio.restore.title: Continue where you left off?
studio.restore.body: You have changes that aren't applied to the lock screen yet.
studio.restore.bodyAt: You have changes from %1 that aren't applied to the lock screen yet.
studio.restore.savedHint: Deletes the draft and starts from the lock screen's look.
studio.quit.title: Apply your changes before you quit?
studio.quit.body: The lock screen doesn't have your changes yet. Discard deletes them, and the draft too.
studio.quit.discardHint: Quits without applying and deletes the draft.
studio.video.plan: Uses all of it, scaled to %1 × %2, %3 fps, no sound
studio.video.planCut: Uses the first %1 s, scaled to %2 × %3, %4 fps, no sound
studio.video.why: It makes a clip the lock screen can play, in the helper's sandbox at low priority, and only when you press Convert.
studio.video.problem.decode-failed: This video can't be read; it may be damaged.
studio.video.problem.unsupported-format: Not a video the lock screen can use: choose an MP4, MOV, MKV or WebM file.
studio.video.problem.video-missing: The video is gone: choose it again.
studio.video.problem.decoder-unavailable: Converting videos needs ffmpeg and Bubblewrap.
studio.video.limit.input-too-large: Over the 2 GiB limit: the lock screen can't use this video.
studio.video.limit.unsupported-codec: %1 video isn't supported: the lock screen takes H.264, HEVC, VP8, VP9 or AV1.
studio.video.limit.input-too-wide: Larger than 7680 × 4320: the lock screen can't use this video.
studio.video.failed.busy: Another conversion is running. Try again when it is done.
studio.video.failed.job-timeout: The conversion took over 10 minutes and was stopped.
studio.video.failed.output-too-large: The clip came out over 150 MiB, so it was not kept.
studio.motion.hint: Play is experimental: the lock screen decodes the clip itself. It plays only with GPU rendering, and holds still while the display sleeps or motion is reduced.
studio.motion.needsClip: Convert the video to play it on the lock screen.
studio.login.state.not-installed: The login screen (SDDM) shows its own theme. Copy this look to show it there too.
studio.login.state.current: The login screen matches this look.
studio.login.state.outdated: The login screen shows an older look.
studio.login.state.installed: The login screen uses Foamy Lock's theme.
studio.login.state.overridden: Foamy Lock's login theme is installed, but SDDM uses %1.
studio.login.state.overriddenIn: Foamy Lock's login theme is installed, but SDDM uses %1, set in %2.
studio.login.state.overriddenBuiltIn: Foamy Lock's login theme is installed, but SDDM uses its built-in theme.
studio.login.state.broken: The login theme files are incomplete.
studio.login.unapplied: Changes you haven't applied aren't copied: the login screen gets the look the lock screen has.
studio.login.compareFailed: This look couldn't be compared with it: %1.
studio.login.reason.not-possible: it isn't possible in this state
studio.login.reason.NOT_OURS: a theme or setting with Foamy Lock's name isn't Foamy Lock's, so it was left alone
studio.login.reason.BUNDLE_INVALID: the plugin's login theme files are damaged
studio.login.reason.TIMEOUT: it took too long and was stopped
studio.login.reason.IO: a file couldn't be read or written
studio.login.reason.INVALID_REQUEST: the look or the theme colours were refused
studio.login.reason.lock-status: Foamy Lock didn't say which profile picture it shows
studio.login.result.copy.done: Copied. The login screen shows this look.
studio.login.result.denied: Permission wasn't granted (or no password prompt could open): nothing was changed.
studio.login.result.copy.unconfirmed: The copy reported success, but the login screen doesn't show this look (%1).
studio.login.result.restore.unconfirmed: The removal reported success, but Foamy Lock's login theme is still in use (%1).
studio.login.result.copy.failedNothing: Couldn't copy to the login screen: %1. Nothing was changed.
studio.login.result.copy.failed: Couldn't copy to the login screen: %1.
studio.login.result.restore.failedNothin: Couldn't remove Foamy Lock from the login screen: %1. Nothing was changed.
studio.login.result.restore.failed: Couldn't remove Foamy Lock from the login screen: %1.
studio.login.ask.copy.intro: This copies the lock screen's look to the login screen (SDDM). The login screen shows when the computer starts and after you log out.
studio.login.ask.copy.steps:
It will:
• install or update Foamy Lock's login theme in /usr/share/sddm/themes/foamy-lock
• copy the layout, colours, background picture, your name and your profile picture there. Anyone at this computer can see them on the login screen.
• select the theme in /etc/sddm.conf.d/99-zz-foamy-lock.conf
studio.login.ask.copy.stepsNoPicture:
It will:
• install or update Foamy Lock's login theme in /usr/share/sddm/themes/foamy-lock
• copy the layout, colours, your name and your profile picture there. Anyone at this computer can see them on the login screen.
• select the theme in /etc/sddm.conf.d/99-zz-foamy-lock.conf
studio.login.ask.copy.replaces: This replaces the login theme %1. Removing Foamy Lock from the login screen brings it back.
studio.login.ask.copy.replacesIn: This replaces the login theme %1, set in %2. Removing Foamy Lock from the login screen brings it back.
studio.login.ask.copy.leftOut: Not shown on the login screen: %1.
studio.login.leftOut.video: the video background (its still frame shows instead)
studio.login.ask.root: This needs administrator (root) permission. You will be asked for your password.
studio.login.ask.autologin: Autologin is on, so you see the login screen only after you log out.
studio.login.ask.restore.body: The login screen goes back to the theme your other SDDM settings select, usually Omarchy's. This removes /usr/share/sddm/themes/foamy-lock and /etc/sddm.conf.d/99-zz-foamy-lock.conf.
studio.login.ask.restore.title: Remove Foamy Lock from the login screen?
